name: Cafe Pub Black Horse
kurzbeschreibung: The Black Horse Café Pub in Innsbruck Welcome to Café Pub Black Horse in the heart of Innsbruck, where traditional Tyrolean charm meets modern pub vibes.
beschreibung: The Cafe Pub Black Horse in Innsbruck is an authentic local gathering spot combining the relaxed charm of an Austrian café with the casual energy of a classic pub. Guests can unwind with draft beers, regional wines, or specialty coffees, accompanied by tasty bar bites. The welcoming interior and lively neighborhood atmosphere make it a favorite for catching up after work or starting an enjoyable evening out.
